visual.name: histogram
visual.description: A Power BI custom visual for rendering histograms of continuous numeric data.

dataRoles.name: values
dataRoles.description: The numeric field to bin into a histogram.

dataRoles.name: weight
dataRoles.description: Sets the bar height. Set this field's aggregation to control how it's combined.

dataRoles.name: rowKey
dataRoles.description: Optional. A unique row identifier. Prevents rows with repeated values from being merged, and makes Average exact.

dataRoles.name: legend
dataRoles.description: Optional. Colors the histogram by category.

dataRoles.name: smallMultiples
dataRoles.description: Optional. Splits the histogram into a grid of panels, one per category.

dataRoles.name: weightReference
dataRoles.description: Optional. Draws a reference line at each bound measure's value on the weight axis. Add more than one for multiple lines.
